recordings.name: platform
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator with user verification, whose credentials are not backup eligible; the third login is user-scoped, and the signature counter is reset to zero before the last.

recordings.name: synced
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator whose credentials are backup eligible and backed up.

recordings.name: backup-eligible
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator whose credentials are backup eligible but not backed up; the credential is backed up between the first and the second login, and not backed up again before the third.

recordings.name: security-key
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 USB authenticator with user verification.

recordings.name: hybrid
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 authenticator reached over the hybrid transport (a phone), with user verification, whose credentials are backup eligible and backed up.

recordings.name: no-user-verification
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator without user verification, registered with conditional options in a modal ceremony: Chrome creates the credential, but refuses to assert it with user verification required, so there are no logins.

recordings.name: conditional
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator whose credentials are backup eligible and backed up, that clears the user presence and user verification flags at registration, as in a conditional creation, then verifies the user in its assertions.

recordings.name: uv-cleared-after-registration
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator that verifies the user at registration, then clears the user verification flag in its assertions: a client not honoring the user verification requirement.

recordings.name: uv-set-up-after-registration
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator that clears the user verification flag at registration, then verifies the user in its assertions: a security key whose PIN was set up after registration, possibly by whoever took it.

recordings.name: no-user-presence
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator that clears the user presence flag in every response.

recordings.name: bogus-signature
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator whose assertion signatures are zeroed.

recordings.name: backed-up-not-eligible
recordings.description: A CTAP2.1 platform authenticator whose credential is marked backed up but not backup eligible after registration.
